exposure: Gestational age at first bleeding episode
occurrence of 3 or more episodes of antepartum of uterine bleeding
moderate or severe antepartum uterine bleeding
a first (sentinel) bleeding episode before 29 weeks of gestation
cohort: 250 women presenting with antepartum bleeding and placenta praevia from 20 weeks of gestation until term in three maternity units
finding: Major praevia, 3 or more bleeding episodes, and first bleeding episode before 29 weeks gestation were significantly associated with emergency cesareans.
